apply.title: Ohereza ubusabe
apply.category_help: Hitamo icyiciro. Umurongo wa backend ni wo ugena urwego rubishinzwe hashingiwe kuri iki cyiciro.
apply.agency_derived: Iki cyiciro gishinzwe {{agency}}. Ntugomba guhitamo cyangwa kohereza urwego.

categories.OFFICER_FOUR_YEAR_UR: RCS — ofisiye w’imyaka ine muri UR

apply.education_help: Andika nimero ya {{registry}} isabwa kuri iki cyiciro. Ni yo nimero y’amashuri backend isaba kuri iki cyiciro.
apply.declaration_copy: Ndemeza ko amakuru ntanze ari ukuri kandi yuzuye. Uku kwemeza ni ukw’iyi fomu gusa; ibyo twohereza kuri backend ni icyiciro na nimero y’amashuri byemewe gusa.
apply.review_body: Kohereza bizohereza gusa icyiciro na nimero y’amashuri bisabwa binyuze muri session y’usaba. Backend ni yo igena dosiye n’imimerere yayo.
apply.success_body: Backend yakiriye ubusabe bwawe. Urutonde rw’ubusabe bwawe ruvuguruwe; nta makuru y’ubusabe yahimbwe hashingiwe ku gisubizo cyo kohereza.
apply.replay_body: Backend yongeye gutanga igisubizo cy’ukohereza kwabanje kuri iyi nimero y’umutekano. Urutonde rw’ubusabe bwawe ruvuguruwe.
apply.validation_body: Backend yanze ibice by’ubusabe cyangwa nimero y’umutekano. Genzura fomu wongere ugerageze.
apply.duplicate_body: Backend ivuga ko usanzwe ufite ubusabe kuri aya mahirwe yo gushaka akazi. Urutonde rw’ubusabe ni rwo kuriya.
apply.conflict_body: Backend ntishobora kwakira ubu busabe muri iyi mimerere.

conflicts.NO_OPEN_CAMPAIGN: Nta gikorwa cyo gushaka abakozi gifunguye kuri iki cyiciro.
conflicts.CROSS_AGENCY_ACCEPT_LOCK: Ubu busabe bwabujijwe n’ifunga ryo kwemererwa risanzweho.
conflicts.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: Backend ntishobora kwakira ubu busabe muri iyi mimerere.

apply.offline_body: Draft yawe igumye kuri iki gikoresho. Kohereza bisaba umurongo wa applicant edge; nta busabe bwoherejwe.
apply.dependency_body: Backend ntiyabashije kugera kuri serivisi isabwa. Draft yawe igumye kuri iki gikoresho; wongere ugerageze nyuma.
apply.session_body: Session yawe yarangiye cyangwa ntiboneka. Ongera winjire mbere yo kohereza.
apply.forbidden_body: Backend yanze iyi session cyangwa uburinzi bwa CSRF. Ongera winjire wongere ugerageze.
apply.rate_limit_body: Tegereza gato mbere yo kongera kohereza ubusabe.
